title: Nexzek BizHub user manual
subtitle: A practical guide for business owners, employees and the platform operator.

sections.title: 1. Create your business
steps: Open the main BizHub app and choose Create your business. If the site is marked Preview, account access is still being connected; use this guide until registration opens.
Create an account, open the verification email and confirm your address. Return to the app and sign in.
Enter your company name, contact details, category and business URL name. For example, choose nex to use nex.nexzekbizhub.com after the shared domain is connected.
Choose an available plan and create the company. Plan names, trial periods and prices are set by the platform operator.
Open My workspaces to enter your business or switch between companies. Your company administrator controls employee access.
sections.note: The business URL name becomes your assigned BizHub subdomain. Choose it carefully. Names such as app, www, api and admin are reserved.

sections.title: 2. Set up products and stock
steps: Open your company workspace, then Commerce & inventory. Your plan must include commerce.
In Locations, create a branch, then add a warehouse within that branch.
In Products, create a category. Add a product with its name, URL slug, price in naira, image URL and description. Add choices such as Size if needed.
Save the product. Use Edit product to change its details or turn publishing on or off.
In Inventory, select the warehouse and product. Enter a positive quantity to receive stock, or a negative quantity to make a correction. Record a clear reason.
Review on-hand, reserved and available quantities. A stock correction cannot reduce inventory below the quantity already reserved.
sections.note: Creating a product does not receive stock. Receive stock separately in the correct warehouse.

sections.title: 3. Invite employees and assign access
steps: Use the Team section in your company workspace to invite an employee. They must confirm their account and accept access.
Open Commerce & inventory > Permissions. Create a role with only the permissions the employee needs.
Assign the role to that employee with company, branch or warehouse scope. A warehouse officer should normally receive one warehouse.
Include inventory.read when granting inventory.adjust, and catalogue.read when granting catalogue.edit.
Use Revoke on an assignment when access is no longer needed. Ask employees to use their own accounts; do not share the administrator login.
sections.note: A company administrator can manage the entire company. Other employees require explicit commerce permissions. An employee with access to one warehouse cannot adjust stock in another.

sections.title: 4. Apply your branding and open the store
steps: Open Branding in the company workspace. Set your name, colours, approved font and logo, then save a draft.
Preview the changes and publish when ready. Previous published versions can be restored.
For a logo upload, open Account & billing > Private company files, choose Logos and upload a supported image. Use as company logo publishes that selected image.
Open Commerce & inventory > Storefront. Choose the warehouse that will fulfil orders, set the delivery fee and publish the store.
The platform operator must verify and link your business settlement subaccount before checkout can open.
Share the central store link, your assigned BizHub subdomain or your activated custom domain. Only the fulfilment warehouse's available stock is offered to shoppers.
sections.note: Private company documents stay private. Product images need a suitable HTTPS image URL; publishing a selected logo intentionally makes that logo public.

sections.title: 5. Shop, pay and fulfil orders
steps: Customers browse the business store, choose product options and add items to their bag.
On a business domain, Continue to secure checkout brings the bag into the central BizHub app. Prices are checked again; no card details or passwords are transferred from the store.
The customer signs in, enters delivery details and continues to the payment provider. Stock is reserved for 30 minutes while payment is pending.
A return page alone does not prove payment. The app independently verifies the provider's reference, amount, currency and settlement recipient.
In Commerce & inventory > Orders, review paid orders. Mark an eligible order Ready for dispatch and then Confirm delivered as fulfilment progresses.
Customers should keep their order confirmation URL. Company staff see only orders their location permissions allow.
sections.note: If a payment is uncertain, verify the existing reference before starting another attempt. Late or ambiguous payments need reconciliation; do not assume they failed and charge again.

sections.title: 6. Manage your subscription and files
steps: Open Account & billing to see your plan, period end, employee usage, storage usage and invoices.
Choose a published plan and billing cycle when a new payment is available. Review the amount before continuing to Paystack.
Automatic renewal is optional. Tick its authorization box only if you want the selected price and cycle to repeat. An eligible reusable payment method is required.
Use Turn off automatic renewal to stop future unsent charges. Cancel at period end keeps the current paid period and stops renewal access after it ends.
If a renewal fails, review the billing notice and verify the payment. Existing business records are retained when operational writes become read-only.
Upload supported PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF files within the plan's allowance. Downloads are private, time-limited links.
sections.note: An already submitted charge must still be reconciled after cancellation. Do not remove encryption keys or change provider accounts as a way to reverse payments.

sections.title: 7. Use nex.nexzekbizhub.com
steps: Choose nex as your company URL name during registration. The app assigns the corresponding label to that company.
The platform operator connects nexzekbizhub.com and its wildcard domain once in the Vercel project and sets up DNS and HTTPS.
You do not need to buy a domain or add DNS records for your assigned BizHub subdomain.
Check Your business address in Account & billing, then publish your storefront. The address opens the correct company's branded store.
Unknown, reserved or inactive subdomains do not open another business's store.
sections.note: nex.nexzekbizhub.com is an example of the requested format. It becomes usable only after the platform domain, wildcard certificate and your business store are active.

sections.title: 8. Connect a domain such as wenlas.com
steps: Create your company and publish its store. Confirm that you control the DNS account for the domain.
In Account & billing > Your domains, enter wenlas.com without https:// or a path, then choose Add domain.

Copy the app's TXT challenge. At your DNS provider add a TXT record named _saas-verification with the exact saas-verification=... value shown by the app. Some providers require the full name _saas-verification.wenlas.com.
Wait for DNS to update, return to the app and choose Verify DNS. Keep the TXT record for future checks.
Ask the platform operator to add wenlas.com to the same Vercel project. The operator supplies the exact A or CNAME records shown by Vercel. Add these website records at your DNS provider.
If Vercel asks for an additional ownership TXT record, add that exact record too. Vercel's record and the app's _saas-verification record are separate checks.
After Vercel reports valid DNS and HTTPS, the platform operator activates the domain in Platform billing > Domain commissioning.

Open https://wenlas.com. Its address remains in the browser while customers shop. Staff sign-in and payment checkout use the central secure app. Review the ownership expiry date and reverify before it expires.
sections.note: Do not change email MX, SPF, DKIM or DMARC records just to connect the website. Add www.wenlas.com only if you also want that hostname; it needs its own Vercel configuration or an HTTPS redirect to the main domain.

sections.title: 9. Platform operator: connect the shared domain
steps: Deploy the app to the Nexzek Technology Vercel account. Keep Supabase as the shared production database. Configure the new project's credentials privately; never copy the old project's keys.
Choose one central HTTPS app address for sign-in and checkout. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to it and configure the matching Supabase Auth Site URL and redirect URLs.
In Vercel > Project settings > Domains, add nexzekbizhub.com and *.nexzekbizhub.com to the same project.

Use the exact DNS values Vercel provides. For wildcard certificates, either use Vercel nameservers after copying all existing DNS records, or retain your DNS provider and follow Vercel's _acme-challenge delegation instructions.

If using external DNS, delegate _acme-challenge with both Vercel NS records and add the wildcard website CNAME. The certificate challenge delegation and website routing record serve different purposes.
After DNS and HTTPS are valid, configure SAAS_TENANT_ROOT_DOMAIN=nexzekbizhub.com and enable SAAS_DOMAIN_ROUTING. Reserved platform hostnames must not be assigned to tenants.
Use an explicitly granted platform administrator account with MFA for plans, prices, suspension, settlement accounts and domain activation.

Configure the authenticated billing worker and monitor its heartbeat. A five-minute worker requires a compatible Vercel schedule or another approved scheduler; do not assume a Hobby plan supports frequent cron jobs.
sections.note: Do not move nameservers without first preserving existing website, email and verification records. Do not activate a customer's domain until its ownership, website routing and HTTPS are verified.

sections.title: 10. Troubleshooting and current boundaries
steps: Domain unavailable: check that the domain or assigned subdomain belongs to this company, its ownership verification is current, HTTPS is active and the store is published.
Store is empty: publish products and check their category, image and fulfilment warehouse stock.
Employee sees no stock: verify active membership, role permissions and the exact assigned branch or warehouse.
Checkout unavailable: check the subscription's write access, published storefront, active fulfilment location and verified settlement account.
Payment pending: verify the original reference. The operator should inspect failed or review jobs rather than repeat an uncertain charge.
Email link fails: use the latest verification link and ask the operator to check the central Auth redirect and email settings.

This release provides company catalogue, warehouse stock, orders, branded stores, scoped access and subscription billing. Legacy POS, advanced procurement/transfers, tenant refunds/reports, customer history and other enterprise additions are tracked separately; do not assume every legacy module is enabled for new companies.
sections.note: A labelled preview is for review. Real registration, uploads, billing, domain activation and scheduled processing require their hosting and service setup to be completed.
